{{Listen3|B5C-SWTOR.flac|a B5C|A B5C starts up, idles, drives, and then retracts and extends its outriggers}}
The '''B5C''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] developed by [[K-NorCo]],<ref name="Bundle" /> which also produced the [[B5B]] speeder bike.<ref name="B5B">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|[[K-NorCo]] [[B5B]]|the Cartel Market}}</ref> The B5C had a single [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] seat at the back of its short pod-shaped chassis with steering grips in front of it. The front of the chassis had a small light mounted above two pairs of black [[Outrigger/Legends|outrigger]]s, one sitting above the other and extending slightly further from the front of the vehicle.<ref name="Bundle" />

The vanes could retract inside the chassis separately, leaving only the [[Steering vane/Legends|steering vane]]s at the end exposed. The B5C's chassis and vanes were colored magenta and dark turquoise, with white detailing. The model was available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Bundle" />

==Behind the scenes==
The B5C first appeared during the [[2022]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] expansion for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''<ref name="Bundle" /> where it was made available to both Republic and Empire players as part of the "Join The Fight Bundle," released through the game's online store on [[September 21]], [[2023]].<ref name="Store">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230921|text=The Join the Fight Bundle is now available!}}</ref>
